notes: The manuscript opens d'où, au moins au dessus de Z[1/2] and labels its two live formulas (79). It writes [M_{1,1}]=1/2(T(1)-1)-1/12 and [hat M_{1,1}]=[M_{1,1}]+[hat M^infinity_{1,1}]=1/2(T(1)-1)+5/12, with a vertical equality and 1/2 under the boundary term. Two abandoned trials precede the live right-hand expressions. These are manuscript formulas, not established motive identities in this reading.

The manuscript announces another calculation of [M_{1,1}] using the modular morphism M_{1,1} to the double-stroked E^1 and a cutting by sections S_0 and S_1. It calls the first curve elliptique harmonique and writes the group Z/4Z. The second curve has the retained doubtful words bonne and avec un bon before gr. d'automs Z/6Z. Those words are transcribed from their short ink outlines, not replaced by expected terminology.

The manuscript claims the two sections meet only at the points 2 and 3 and associates them, with its explicit qualification (sauf erreur), to automorphism groups of orders 24 and 12. The orders, the intersection claim, and the description of the corresponding curves have not been proved or independently checked here.

The manuscript then writes a partition of E^1 with two amalgamation signs followed by two ordinary union signs and defines U above the lower brace; the brace groups only the intersection equation for {a_2,a_3} and the definitions of S'_0 and S'_1. In U's line the source mark after E^1 remains +|set-minus, with the cross-like reading first. This possible author slip or ambiguous sign is not silently corrected. The vertical characteristic labels read car 2 and car. 3, retaining their local punctuation.

Explicit arithmetic check performed in this reading: if A=1/2(T(1)-1)-1/12 and the boundary value is 1/2, then A+1/2=1/2(T(1)-1)+(-1/12+6/12)=1/2(T(1)-1)+5/12, exactly the second live expression in (79). This checks only the addition of the displayed constants; it neither proves either motive formula nor deciphers either canceled trial.

Seven canceled spans are represented: the two upper trials, et, the doubtful old subscript 0 under the live section index 1, the short relation/Z trial after that section, the E-like symbol in the partition, and the pair after où. The six canceled spans already present in C were each checked for extent and placement; the index overwrite is an additional shared omission. All six canceled candidates other than plain et remain under doubt. M1041 and M1042 are also unresolved.

Physical line count is 24: 20 principal body rows (counting each equation row as one rather than its numerator/denominator separately), two lower annotation baselines (the boundary 1/2, and the paired characteristic labels), the own page-number row, and the pencil-foliation row. Read full scan once for layout and both native halves once; all 12 saved crop places were then viewed individually. Macro-only wrapper differences and certainty alone are not counted as changes.
